# SYS001: sys-unowned

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

| since | 2.0.0 |

An artifact in the walk that no node owns.

Fires when no unit of the artifact has an owner and the artifact hides nothing a selector could claim; reported once per directory. Unresolved when an owner is May only, the artifact has an unseen remainder, or only a symbol selector could own an F0 file. An artifact under a `modeled` selector is SYS005's. Error under `[grimble] strict`.

## Examples

### SYS001 sys-unowned / An artifact no node owns fires #1 (line 6) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node a : trusted { owns "src/**"; }
node d : trusted { owns "design/**"; }
=== docs/loose.txt
nobody owns this
```

### SYS001 sys-unowned / Every artifact owned is clean #2 (line 17) (clean)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node a : trusted { owns "src/**"; owns "docs/**"; owns "grimble.toml"; }
node d : trusted { owns "design/**"; }
=== docs/loose.txt
owned by a
```
